values.content:
=You are a log parser. Analyze these system logs and extract ONLY security events related to IP {{ $('Normalize Alert Data1').item.json.body.data.srcip }}

## Logs
{{ $json.stdout }}

## Output (max 1500 chars)

**Source Ip 
**Failed Logins:** [count, usernames]
**Successful Logins:** [yes/no, when]
**Ports Targeted:** [list]
**Attack Pattern:** [brute force/scan/exploit/other]
**First/Last Seen:** [timestamps]
**Severity:** [Low/Medium/High]
**Key Log Lines:** [2-3 most important entries]

Be specific with numbers and timestamps. If no relevant logs, say "NONE".

Do not summarize, triage.
